Pulse Engage uses your device's motion sensors to count steps accurately and verify that fitness challenge progress is genuine.
Pulse Engage reads your step count from Apple Health to award points and track wellness challenge progress.
Pulse Engage writes workout sessions to Apple Health when you complete activity-based wellness challenges.
Pulse Engage uses your approximate location only to cross-verify step authenticity for the anti-cheat trust score. Your location is never shared or stored on a server.
Pulse Engage needs camera access so you can upload a profile photo and attach images to social wall posts.
Pulse Engage needs photo library access so you can pick a profile picture and attach images to social wall posts.
Pulse Engage saves shareable achievement cards and reward QR codes to your photo library.
Pulse Engage sends notifications for daily wellness nudges, challenge milestones, coffee-roulette matches, and points earned.
Pulse Engage adds office events you register for to your calendar so you never miss them.
Pulse Engage uses contacts only to suggest co-workers you might want to tag in recognition posts. Contact data never leaves your device.
Pulse Engage connects to fitness wearables over Bluetooth to import step data more accurately.
